name: PD 188 was established by Ordinance No. 18489, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 5, 1984. Ordinance No. 18489 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 188 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 188 was established by Ordinance No. 18489, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 5, 1984. Ordinance No. 18489 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 188 is established on property generally fronting on the east line of Netherland Drive, south of Royal Lane. The size of PD 188 is approximately 3.6 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-188.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development of this site must be in accordance with the development plan (Exhibit 188A). (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.105.USES. The only permitted uses are six single-family detached dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Minimum Lot Area
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.106.MINIMUM LOT AREA. Minimum lot area is 21,780 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Minimum Front Yard
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.107.MINIMUM FRONT YARD. Minimum front yard is 35 feet. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Minimum Rear Yard
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.108.MINIMUM REAR YARD. Minimum rear yard is 15 feet. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Garages
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.109.GARAGES. No garages are permitted that face directly onto the interior street serving the development. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Window Openings
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-188.110.WINDOW OPENINGS.
(a)In order to restrict visibility in certain areas, no windows or openings are permitted beginning 10 feet from the grade (ground) level (or at what might be termed as a second story) except that windows or openings are permitted within the proscribed area if their only purpose is to emit light into the structure, and if the windows or openings are over eight feet from a finished interior floor level.
(b)These window opening restrictions apply to the following locations within the Property:
(1)Lot 3.The restrictions apply to any wall facing due east.
(2)Lot 4. The restrictions apply to walls facing due east and due south.
(3)Lots 5 and 6.The restrictions apply only to walls facing due south. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.111.MAXIMUM HEIGHT. Maximum permitted height for any structure is 35 feet with no more than two occupied floors. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-188.112.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Utilization of the Property must be in compliance with the requirements of all other applicable codes and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18489; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-188.113.ZONING MAP. PD 188 is located on Zoning Map No. E-7. (Ord Nos. 18489; 25508)
